name: dsh-mermaid-studio
description: Render mermaid fences in DeepSeek Harness chat as diagrams: zoom/pan, fullscreen, SVG/PNG/JPG export, diagram/source toggle, light/dark three-state theme, and IndexedDB-persisted render results so a revisited conversation does not re-render. DSH 对话中的 mermaid 围栏实时成图：缩放/全屏/导出、图源切换、深浅色三态，渲染结果落 IndexedDB，切回会话零重渲染。
author: Hanka
